project: Student Segmentation for Responsible Support Planning
outcome_policy: Outcome columns are quarantined and must never enter clustering features, preprocessing, K selection, or model training. They may be used only for post-hoc validation after the clustering model has been locked.

video_policy.sentinel_handling: Convert sentinel values to missing and retain a sentinel flag. Do not replace them with zero or impute them because video plays are audit-only and are excluded from clustering.
video_policy.duration_policy: The dataset does not contain video duration. Report video plays, missingness, sentinel values, and outliers only. Do not claim to measure video duration.

age_policy.handling: Flag and set ages below 6 to missing. Do not impose an upper age limit because older learners can validly participate in MOOC courses. Age is profile-only and is excluded from clustering.

grade_audit_policy.zero_grade_policy: A grade of zero is retained as a valid observed outcome. Do not remove all grade-zero records.
grade_audit_policy.inconsistency_rule: Flag records where certified equals 1 and grade equals 0, or where certified equals 1 and grade is below the documented passing threshold.
grade_audit_policy.use_in_clustering: Never use grade or certification status as a clustering feature.

numerical_threshold_policy: Use observed distributions, data-quality evidence, and documented rationale. Do not assume universal cutoffs.
supported_new_data: Later MOOC cohorts with the same raw person-course schema, identical field definitions, and documented handling for missing video values.
incompatible_data_policy: If fields, definitions, course structures, or outcome meanings differ, restart from Step 2, update the schema mapping, rerun cleaning and retrain the clustering model.
